big: Nifty Consumer Durables is a snapshot of one slice of the market. Its factsheet answers four quick questions: how many stocks, what is the valuation, who is on top and how concentrated is it.

h: What is the Nifty Consumer Durables?
lines: What does the Nifty Consumer Durables track?
The Nifty Consumer Durables Index is designed to reflect the behaviour and performance of the companies belonging to Consumer Durables industry. It holds 14 stocks and is rebalanced twice a year.
